title: Memory-First Fact-Checking: A Knowledge-Graph-Grounded Multi-Agent System for Misinformation Detection
abstract: arXiv:2608.29617v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: This paper introduces a hybrid fact-checking framework that integrates Knowledge Graph-based semantic memory with adversarial multi-agent reasoning for explainable misinformation detection. The proposed system follows a memory-first, web-fallback architecture, in which input claims are initially evaluated against a dual-index Knowledge Graph through Sentence-BERT-based semantic retrieval and Natural Language Inference. When the evidence retrieved from the graph is insufficient to support a reliable decision, the framework collects information from trusted web sources and assesses it using an adversarial tribunal composed of support, contradiction, and judging agents. A graph-aware confidence mechanism combines semantic similarity, NLI confidence, and structural graph evidence to determine whether internal knowledge is sufficient, thereby reducing unnecessary web retrieval. translated_abstract: 本文提出了一种混合式事实核查框架，将基于知识图谱的语义记忆与对抗性多智能体推理相结合，用于可解释的虚假信息检测。该系统遵循“记忆优先、网络回退”的架构：输入的声明首先通过基于Sentence-BERT的语义检索和自然语言推理（NLI）与双索引知识图谱进行比对评估。当从图谱中检索到的证据不足以支持可靠判断时，该框架会从可信的网络来源收集信息，并由一个由支持智能体、反驳智能体和裁判智能体组成的对抗性评审团进行评估。一种图感知的置信度机制结合语义相似度、NLI置信度和结构化图谱证据来判断内部知识是否充足，从而减少不必要的网络检索。在验证完成后，经过验证的信息会被转化……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文提出了一种记忆优先、网络回退的混合事实核查框架，通过知识图谱语义检索与支持-反驳-裁判三方对抗性多智能体推理相结合，并利用图感知置信度机制判断内部知识是否充足，从而实现可解释的虚假信息检测并减少不必要的网络检索。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a memory-first, web-fallback hybrid fact-checking framework that combines knowledge graph semantic retrieval with an adversarial tribunal of support, contradiction, and judging agents, using a graph-aware confidence mechanism to enable explainable misinformation detection while reducing unnecessary web retrieval.
